name: jubarte
description: Read, edit, redline, compare and render Word documents with real tracked changes, using one local open-source engine.

interface.shortDescription: Tracked changes, redlines and PDF for Word documents
interface.longDescription: Read a .docx with paragraph ids, apply exact edits as Word tracked changes with comments, compare two versions into a redline, accept or reject changes, check that Word will open the result, and render pages to PDF or PNG. One local engine over stdio: no LibreOffice, no account, no upload.
defaultPrompt: Redline this contract as tracked changes with a comment on each change
Compare these two drafts and show me what changed
Render this Word document to PDF and check the pages
